albums.title: Tidewater Hymnal
albums.notes:
Recorded in a decommissioned lighthouse — you can hear the stairwell on every vocal.

Best track: "Fog Signal". Play it loud, late, with the window open.

albums.title: Sodium Nights
albums.notes: Side A is a slow burn; side B > side A. The synth on track 6 sounds like a streetlight humming.

albums.title: Field Recordings for an Empty Room
albums.notes: Recommended by M. at the record fair. Supposedly the piano was left slightly out of tune on purpose.

albums.title: Concrete Garden
albums.notes: Brutalist ambient. Strange that something this cold can feel so kind.

albums.title: Paper Moons over Osaka
albums.notes:
Bought on the strength of the sleeve alone.

Third listen: the title track keeps opening up. The bass clarinet on "Harbour Light, 2 a.m." is the whole reason to own this.

To do: find the 2019 live session they mention in the liner notes.

albums.title: VII
albums.notes: Seven pieces, seven time signatures. Mathematical, never cold.

albums.title: A Brief History of Rain (Expanded Edition, Remastered from the Original Reel-to-Reel Tapes)
albums.artist: Theo Marchetti and the Cellar Strings Ensemble
